name: Half-Life for iOS (unofficial, Xash3D FWGS)
subtitle: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift on iPhone
description:
An unofficial fan port of Xash3D FWGS, the open-source engine for Half-Life, to iPhone, with touch controls. One app plays Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift, plus experimental extras: Half-Life co-op, Multiplayer Modes and Counter-Strike 1.6.

You need your own Steam copy of each game. No game files are included.

It's a beta. Setup guide and bug reports: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/xash3d-fwgs

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve or Gearbox Software, or by the Xash3D FWGS developers.

apps.name: Half-Life
apps.subtitle: Half-Life, Opposing Force and Blue Shift, with touch controls
apps.localizedDescription:
An unofficial fan port of Xash3D FWGS to iPhone: play Half-Life, Half-Life: Opposing Force and Half-Life: Blue Shift with touch controls, picked on the app's own Choose a game screen.

- Touch controls: a move stick where your thumb lands, drag to look, a weapon wheel
- SAVE and LOAD: tap for the game's menus, hold to quick save and quick load
- Tilt aiming (gyro), 60 or 120 frames a second
- A camera: photos, selfies with the characters near you, bursts, and Action Freeze, a free camera around a frozen moment
- A cheat (type sithewok): god mode, all weapons, noclip, and LEVEL to jump to any chapter
- Experimental: Half-Life co-op for up to 4 players, Multiplayer Modes, and Counter-Strike 1.6

You need your own Steam copy of Half-Life (and of Opposing Force, Blue Shift or Counter-Strike to play those); no game files are included. Open the app once, then copy the game folders (valve, gearbox, bshift, cstrike) into Files > On My iPhone > Half-Life.

It's a beta, tested on one iPhone: expect bugs, and back up your saves. Multiplayer has had the least testing.

Setup guide: https://github.com/sithewok13-dev/xash3d-fwgs#readme

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve or Gearbox Software, or by the Xash3D FWGS developers.
